title: About Mehul Joshi
content: 01 / ABOUT ME, I was born in July 1995. More than just writing code. I started my career in 2016. Today I design, build and lead production systems. I'm Mehul Joshi, a Senior Full Stack Engineer and Technical Lead with 10 years of experience building SaaS products, enterprise applications and mobile platforms. My engineering journey has evolved from backend development to full-stack engineering, system architecture, performance optimization, cloud infrastructure and technical leadership. I enjoy solving difficult engineering problems — especially when scalability, performance, maintainability and reliability matter.

title: Backend Engineering

title: Cloud & DevOps
